## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Purābhedasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 10) is the tenth section of the *Mahāniddesa*, which forms part of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text constitutes an early canonical commentary and lexical exposition on the *Purābhedasutta* from the *Aṭṭhakavagga* of the *Sutta Nipāta*. SuttaCentral records two modern translations of the text in two languages [SuttaCentral]. No dedicated analyses or citations of this individual section were identified in the queried secondary literature search.

According to curated parallels on SuttaCentral, the text shares passage-level parallels with multiple other exegetical sections of the *Mahāniddesa* and *Cullaniddesa*, including the *Kāmasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 1), *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14), *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 16), *Mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 8), *Udayamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 17), *Pārāyanānugītigāthāniddesa* (Cnd 22), and *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23) [SuttaCentral]. Resembling parallels are found in the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (Ds 2.3.2), *Tissametteyyasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 7), and *Upasīvamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 10) [SuttaCentral]. Portions of its verses or subject matter also connect to Dhp 97 and Dhp 321–323, AN 10.69, and their counterparts across the Patna Dharmapada, Gāndhārī Dharmapada, Udānavarga, and Chinese Dharmapada-type collections (T 210, T 212, T 213) [SuttaCentral].
